a.text: Dear Randall. I know your father and I have not written to you since you left Laterano.
While we have both willingly taken up heavy responsibilities in our work, that is no excuse to neglect the things that we should truly cherish.

Perhaps we should not have been so quick to accept your impetuous request to study in a distant land. It is only after experiencing the journey for ourselves that we realized that it is taking enough time for us to complete half a cycle of work—
Yes, we are coming to Leithanien to see you. We are already on our way.
There is no need to write back. We may even have already arrived by the time you receive this letter. I have included the address of the hotel we will stay at.
We will be waiting for you there, even if you are still angry about what you might have perceived as indifference.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Letter for you, Randall Hofstadter.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I don't recall having any friends who would write to me.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: A person's heart is as fickle as the weather, just like that downpour a few days ago that soaked all the letters I was carrying. Sorry, but the sender's name got too blurry to read. I hope that won't be a problem?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: None whatsoever. Looks like it's from my mother back home. Thank you, sir.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: That's good to hear. Have a nice day.

steps.name: Arrogant Student
steps.text: Payne! Did you do what I told you to?

steps.name: Scornful Student
steps.text: Look how scared he is. What a wimp.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I-I did, Herr Viktor.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: See what I said, Britney? Payne would never let his 'friends' down. How did he react?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I'm not sure... Randall might not have believed my story... Maybe we shouldn't—

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: If he didn't, then you'll be in deep trouble, Payne.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: It's not easy, is it, studying in Leithanien by yourself? Your talent with Arts and studiousness habits are admirable. Surely the university's scholarship is intended just for knowledge-seekers like you.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: But who knows what might happen before everything's decided?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Scholarship candidates are subject to stringent checks. Perhaps you'd find it simple to pass the end-term exams with top grades, but the final decision is the committee's to make.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: And your uncle sits on that committee...

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: The list of recipients won't be made public until next week.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I... I'll make sure that Randall comes.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: That's more like it.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Be careful. That's a tall stack of books.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: S-Sorry, Randall.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: You know me?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Er... we took the same elective?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: We did. Your novel views on compatible Originium-energy conversion methods for existing Arts Units gave Professor Edwin quite the headache.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Er, heh... at least he was fair with his grading.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Less so for me. Theory has never been my area of interest, though. There will be few advances in those concepts, even given another five or six decades.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: My toxicology class is in another wing. Have a nice day.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: We seem to be running into each other rather frequently these days. It's almost enough to make me suspect a scheme is at play.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Oh, what an interesting reaction.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: It's not easy finding a friend in a foreign land. We're both international students, after all.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I've been away from home for so long that I've almost forgotten what my family looked like. They... don't write often.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Speaking of which, I did recently receive a letter from my mother.

spans.text: recently receive a letter from my mother.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: What did you think about it... no, I mean, is something the matter?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: My parents wanted to see me, but I'm not sure if I want to see them.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: You must! Er... whatever happens, surely your family care about you.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Are you telling me to go and meet them?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: O-Of course not! It's your choice.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I'll take it into consideration... Perhaps I'll write back to them in a few days.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Y-You will go meet them, won't you?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Why do you seem even more anxious than I am? As you said, the choice is mine.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear... If he refuses, how do I explain it to Herr Viktor?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Wait, Messenger!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Oh, good afternoon, Randall.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Was there something wrong with the letter?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: No, thank you for bringing me my mother's message. But some things are hard to say out loud, after being away from one's family for so long. She said there was no need to write back, but...

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: True, those who've wandered far from home are always hesitant to face their family. I'm willing to deliver a letter for you, but... not to the return address, I'm afraid.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: That won't be an issue. They gave me the address of where they're currently staying. Just deliver it there.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: No problem. I hope you have a lovely reunion.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Thank you. I think I will.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: It's not easy, is it? Studying abroad. Not that my job's easy either. Now—

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: O-One moment, please!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Hello, Payne!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Are you finally ready to send a letter yourself? Two outlanders, both about to reunite with their families. Blessings to you all!

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: No, I'm not sending a letter... I just wanted to ask, could you give me Randall's letter? I'll deliver it for him.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: No can do. How could I make a child do my job for me and still collect the wages for it?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: It's alright, sir. I'm very familiar with Bachshof.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: You know the address?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Er... I... R-Randall's my best friend! His parents did come to Leithanien, but... but they've changed accommodation due to, er, unforeseen reasons.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I happened to run into them on the street. If you send it to the old address, they won't get Randall's heartfelt letter, so—

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Slow down and take a deep breath, okay?

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: I see. So you're saying Randall's a really dear friend of yours, and you don't want anything to go wrong with his family reunion?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Well, aren't you a good egg? Sure, I'll leave the letter to you. And maybe next time, I'll be delivering your letter to your own family.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: We've known each other for three years, so don't be shy now. Parents are always glad to hear from their children, no matter what happened in the past.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Thank you, sir. I'll... think about it.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Please... Please let the answer be yes...

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Th-Thank goodness! He'll be there tomorrow night. I must tell Herr Viktor and Frau Britney so that they could prepare.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: So he doesn't get along too well with his family either. And all this about research... Heh, of course it's about work.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: 'Please do not expect too much from this meeting. Of course I am glad you are here, but the unfamiliar sights of Leithanien's streets are a constant reminder that I am alone.'

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Yes, he's alone too, but...

a.text: But who knows what might happen before everything's decided...
...the final decision is the committee's to make.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Herr Viktor would have my head. I must do this, I—

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I must reconsider this...

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: It's almost time, Britney.

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: What a taskmaster.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Show our new toy a little respect. It'll be ours for a long time.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Are you sure he's coming? Our time is valuable. If he's still not here at the appointed time—

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Then I kiss my scholarship and my last year of peaceful student life goodbye.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I know, Herr Viktor. You don't need to repeat yourself.

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: It's only been a few days since we saw you, and you're finally learning to talk back? Actually, I like it better that way.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Shh, someone's coming. Get your Arts Unit ready, Payne. On my mark...

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: What are you doing, dummkopf?!

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: No. 2 Fuga Street... is this the place?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Are you Randall Hofstadter?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Yes, that's me.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I'm a Messenger for Bachshof. A Sankta couple requested that I meet you here.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: When did you learn to lie like that? An accident and surgery bills? I can hardly believe he actually bought it.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: It's difficult for international students to get timely news from home, and there's no way to quickly verify its authenticity. The same goes for our thoughts, worries, regrets... we can't communicate them to our family.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Find his weakness, and he'll be your most 'loyal' friend for the next few years.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Hm... you're right.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Is that package his most valuable possession? Hardly enough for the medical bills if his poor parents really did encounter an accident in a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: What did you expect from a Sankta runt? I say we're better off using him to try out new Arts.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Randall's parents are scholars on Lateran firearms. Their research institute is officially sponsored. His family should be fairly well-to-do.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I'm sure even your fathers would be pleased if he happens to have any of their research notes with him.

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: Since when did you know him so well?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: It took three years, but you're finally getting the hang of it! Shame you're graduating next year. I won't forget our friendship, Payne.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Neither will I, Herr Viktor.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Do you smell something? Some kind of... aroma?

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: Hmph, a gift obtained through trickery is hardly a proper gift. Besides, my birthday's already past.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: *cough* I smell it now too... what's this? Wait, the box is empty? Damn, that Sankta tricked us... why does your face look so funny, Viktor?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Like yours is any better... No, something's not right. Someone's running up my toes! Or... am I sinking? Arts that change the terrain?

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: The ground's shaking... give me a hand, Viktor—what's this? Green slime? My jeweled ring... no, my finger's gone! I think I'm...

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Melting.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: When you saw a friendless foreign student, did it ever occur to you that I might be choosing to avoid people?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Corrode and dissolve. Those are my Originium Arts, and my innate talent.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I rarely share this with others. Few are willing to delve into the principles of death and decay. So am I fit to be your new 'friend' now?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Payne?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: I should have known! You outlanders were in league with each other! You'll pay for this, traitor!

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Don't bother. I already paid the ultimate price for taking part in your malicious joke.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: A practical joke?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I'm sorry, Randall... I was the one who wrote that letter.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: The children of some nobles made me to write it to trick you... Don't go to the meeting tomorrow!

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I knew it was fake.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: No stamp, no signature, no smell of gun lubricant. Besides, those two never showed the slightest concern when I chose to study in Leithanien.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: In fact, they were relieved, as though my choice had spared them a headache. However, from when I was at a young age, the real 'problem child' of the family was always their research.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Even here in Leithanien, that 'brother' of mine who stole all their attention would never let me go so easily.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Greedy and shortsighted competitors are always trying to steal their research secrets through me. So why should I go easy on the enemies who look down on me?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Most scholars came to Leithanien to delve into the secrets of Originium Arts. I'm no exception.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Sometimes, however, toxicology offers a more effective solution to my 'problems'. A little bit of special ink is enough to turn sweet words into a deadly trap.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: But I should have known that those politicians who continue to wrap themselves in a scholar's garb even after leaving the institute would not be so careless in their forgery.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Alas, I had assumed this was one of those 'problems'.

spans.text: Alas, I had assumed this was one of

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Wait, do you mean... no!

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: It seems there's been a little misunderstanding between us.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: But you started it. I have no reason to apologize.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Hah... haha... I knew it wouldn't end well when I agreed to be their accomplice. I'm the very definition of a scapegoat.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: But I didn't expect the price to be so high...

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I'm sure it's hard to accept. But you can mull over the results of your poor decisions in your own room.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Unless you're planning to take revenge on me? I don't mind, but you'd need to be smarter about it.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: How long do I have...?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Based on experience, no less than three days, no more than one week.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Viktor knows you're coming.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Of course he does. That's why I set the bait. I can't let this practical joke end so easily.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I was preparing my payback before you knocked on my door. It's the perfect opportunity to try out my new solution. Consider it reviewing for the end-term exam.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Count me in.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Oh? And why should I trust a traitor?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: It's true I decided to study abroad partly to get away from my family, but I chose this university to pursue knowledge, not to become a noble's gofer.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: They've always been my enemies.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Traitor!

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Is that the only word he knows? I can't imagine how you let a small-fry like him walk all over you for three years.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Their methods are pathetic even by bully standards—archaic, ineffective, devoid of creativity.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I don't know. I guess I just wanted to have a peaceful school life, but my obedience ended up putting me in even greater peril.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Look, they can't even stand.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: S-Stop your Arts! Get the school nurse, o-or else! Don't you want your scholarship anymore, Payne?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: And you, Randall! Private use of offensive Arts is strictly forbidden! You'll be expelled! You won't be welcome in either Leithanien or Laterano!

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: You understand neither your own situation nor my Originium Arts. These aren't offensive Arts, just hallucinations created by my solution.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: A hallucination? Impossible! I'm certain this pain is real! It's reached my waist... stop! You won't fool us!

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I hate it when I have to explain a practical joke. Can't you figure it out yourself?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: To everyone else, you just fell to the ground on your own and started shouting nonsense while pulling at your own hair and legs. I didn't actually hurt you at all.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Everything you're seeing about your body parts melting, that's just a hobby of mine. The school's rules are too restrictive, so that humble dream of mine only has a place in hallucinations.

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: You monster...

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Thank you, I try.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Viktor, Britney. You're not going to tell anyone what happened tonight, and Randall's 'practical joke' will leave no trace.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: If you tell your dear uncle, there's another near-death hallucination in store for you. Randall has kindly agreed to share the formula for his solution.

steps.name: Britney
steps.text: Just say yes, Viktor! I can't feel my leg anymore! Hurry!

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: I-I won't tell anyone what happened tonight. L-Let us go! Please!

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Are you going to find any new 'friends'?

steps.name: Viktor
steps.text: Absolutely not! I swear! You're the last one! No, not even you anymore! I won't cause any trouble for you!

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Randall.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: The experiment is a success. Thank you for the screams. Now I'll let you go, as a reward for being such cooperative test subjects.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: That's... it? All the dark clouds that have hung over my head for three years, gone just like that?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: It wasn't so complicated.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: No innocent student needs to be bullied and insulted, no getting punched and kicked after a failed plan, and I get to keep my scholarship too?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: It was so simple to resist. Why didn't I understand that until now? But I...

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I still won't apologize.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: You don't need to. Evil deeds deserve to be punished. It's my just deserts.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: But can I ask you to send a letter for me?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: This letter is for your parents?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: They didn't want me to study here in Leithanien. They're merchants who've been running a family business for generations. As their only child, I'm set to inherit it.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Arts tomes were my only companions in my lonely childhood. My parents didn't know Originium Arts, nor were they interested. They just let me do it because I liked it.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: I didn't want to bow my head and seek their help, even as I was being treated like that.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: But I still went to the post office every day to check my mail, dreaming that one day they would show they cared. So just in case, I had this reply letter ready to send without hesitation.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: But there's no point in being stubborn now, in butting heads. I miss my mom's jam tart. I know she made it from off-the-shelf pre-prepared packages, but she always added her own spices.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I don't like desserts.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: But if you miss it, you can always go home.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Hah... very funny. How much longer do I have left? Two days? Five?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Barring any accidents, at least a few decades, I would think.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: ...Is that a joke?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: It's not. That ink wasn't a deadly poison. You'll still have the chance to taste that tart again, though I don't think it sounds especially appetizing.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I just wanted to scare you, but I guess you were more than just a bookworm... Disappointed?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: No... I... *sob*... I've never been so happy...

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Alright, wipe those tears off your face. That wasn't the reaction I expected.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Thanks, Randall. Look... I'm crying so much my hands are growing numb...

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Huh? My... my hands?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I said it wasn't deadly poison. I didn't say it wasn't poison.

spans.text: poison. I didn't say it wasn't poison.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Just a little edema that will make you lose the use of your fingers. They should go back to normal in 72 hours. A much lighter punishment than death, don't you think? Although, now at I think of it—

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: You'll miss the first exam of finals week. Looks like you can kiss your scholarship goodbye after all.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Ha... I should have known. That's more like you.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: You're the one who wrote that 'challenge'. Of course you're in line for the 'payback'. Besides, it was rather irritating watching you cower and grovel before those two.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Not anymore.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Well... you've solved one problem for me, but brought another.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: How will I pay my tuition for next year?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Talk to your folks.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: You already have the letters written. Just change a few words.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Do you know how I saw through the fake letter?

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: You said it was a careless forgery.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: They don't write to me.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Paper, tone, smell—it wasn't any of that detective story BS. The letter itself was meaningless.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: They would never offer me a single word of concern, much less write such a sappy letter—not that I expect anything from them.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: That was the letter that you were hoping for.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Your parents cared about you. You wanted to prove that you're still important to them, and even prepared a response ahead of time.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: It's all so silly, isn't it?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: It is.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: But not because you wrote the letter. Because you wrote it, yet didn't have the courage to send it.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I'm not telling you to bow your head to them. I'm sure you made the right choice, and they made plenty of wrong ones.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: If they see it as a sign of weakness, then be frustrated, be angry, tear the paper to pieces, and tell them it's not.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Do whatever you want.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: How can you always be so confident in your choices?

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Because there's no one to tell me I made the wrong ones.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Haha... I'll think about it.

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: No, I'll send it as soon as my hand heals!

steps.name: Payne
steps.text: Thanks, Randall.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: I told you, that's not the reaction I wanted.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Alright. My reply letter has been safely disposed of, and the practical joke has come to a close. As for this fake letter from Payne...

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: Yeah... doesn't sound anything like what those two would say.

steps.name: Randall
steps.text: But it'll make a decent souvenir.
